⚡ New Energies layouts

Catan: New Energies keeps the familiar island geometry while renaming resources around energy and pollution. Start from a fair shuffle here, then apply the New Energies rules from your rulebook.

Theme vs. classic terrain

  • ⛰️ Mountains → coal
  • 🌲 Forest → biofuel
  • 🧱 Hills → oil
  • 🐑 Pasture → clean energy
  • 🌾 Fields → silicon
  • 🏜️ Desert → barren ground

Because the geometry matches classic Catan, the same balance ideas apply: keep searing dice totals from touching, and spread terrain so several seats stay interesting.

Frequently asked questions

What is Catan: New Energies? ▼

A standalone modern-era Catan game about energy choices, pollution, and climate events. It is not mixed with classic base-game components.

Can I use classic Catan pieces with New Energies? ▼

No. The box is meant to be played on its own with its own cards, tracks, and rules.

Does the island look like classic Catan? ▼

The footprint and dice flow feel familiar—nineteen terrain spaces and eighteen production numbers in the usual pattern—so a fair layout here still matches that geometry.
